messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired PD-2467 — inference-eu-prod: high tail latency and increased 5xx rate. Severity P1. Link: https://pd.example.com/PD-2467. Symptoms: 95th latency > 3s, customer errors reported. Please ack and triage.

sam: acked. I'm oncall and joining. Starting quick triage — attaching initial dashboard.

anya: joining. I'll check embedding queue and autoscaler logs. Any known deploys in the last 30m?

sam: not that I'm aware of. Metrics: request rate steady, but tail latency jump at 02:05 UTC. 5xx rate ~0.8%.

kevin: seeing repeated OOMKill events on several pods in eu-inference pool. Logs snippet: 
```
Mar 15 02:05:11 pod/inference-7c9ff OOMKilled: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError
Mar 15 02:05:12 pod/inference-7c9ff restart
```
Looks like autoscaler didn't add capacity fast enough.

sam: OK — mitigation plan: 1) scale up replicas in eu pool, 2) temporarily route low-priority traffic to us-east variant, 3) restart a subset of pods to drain bad state. Applying step 1 now: `kubectl scale deploy inference-eu --replicas=12 -n inference`

anya: running scale. Also bumping pod memory limit to 6Gi for the heavy model variant: `kubectl patch deployment inference-eu -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"inference","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"6Gi"}}}]}}}}'`

pagerbot: PD update — PD-2467 acknowledged by sam. Escalation: SRE if no resolution in 10m.

kevin: scale command returned success. New pods coming up, but image pull backlog on a couple nodes. Trying `kubectl rollout status` to watch readiness.

sam: bridge created: https://meet.example.com/incident-2467. I'm posting a short customer-facing note: "We saw a transient latency spike in EU inference starting ~02:05 UTC. We've applied capacity increases and mitigations; monitoring for normalization. Will follow up with RCA."

anya: after the scaled replicas reach ready, 95th latency dropped to ~650ms, 5xx back to 0.05%. Still watching for steady state.

kevin: confirmed — no new OOMs after replacing nodes with updated memory limits. Looks like leak/restart storm on a subset of older pods triggered the chain.

oncall-lead: thanks team. Can we hold the page open for 15m and then evaluate for PD close? Assign a post-incident owner for RCA.

sam: agreed. Holding. I'll be owner for RCA and will collect logs + heap dumps from the affected pods. Assigning ticket INF-1123 for follow-up.

anya: leaving a note in the incident runbook: steps taken, memory bump, scale count, quick customer blurb. Will attach graphs. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PD note: Customer update posted by sam. PagerDuty will auto-resolve if no new alerts in 30m.

sam: final quick checklist: confirm autoscaler config (minReplicaCount), check node pressure, and correlate deploy history. If stable after 15m, I'll mark PD resolved and open RCA doc.

anya: monitoring — no regressions for 8m so far.

sam: thanks all. Follow-up: INF-1123 owner sam, RCA timeline due EOD. Closing live mitigation thread once PD clears.
